prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your Companion's Progress", "Log in with your existing account to restore existing pets, or create a new account to safeguard your new pet.", "Sign in with Google or Email to protect your pet"]
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Friend", "Select one of our instant desktop companions to launch right away.", "Instant Pet Templates"]
2: ["Your Pet is Ready for Desktop Duty!", "Use hotkeys or click your taskbar icon anytime to bring your pet to the front.", "Press Alt+P to toggle visibility | Right-click pet to open settings | Click pet to interact"]
3: ["Save Your New Pet to Account", "Sign in now to sync your adoption certificate and pet save across devices.", "Takes less than 10 seconds."]
4: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "Pick 'Express Preset' (30 seconds) or 'Custom AI Photo' (2 minutes).", "You can always create additional custom pets later from settings."]
5: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "For best AI generation results, upload bright, well-lit photos showing your pet's face clearly.", "Avoid blurry pictures or extreme shadows for accurate 3D model generation."]
6: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet...", "We are preparing your pet's animation assets and placing them on your desktop screen.", "Check your system tray if your pet hides behind active application windows."]
7: ["Meet Your Pet on Your Screen!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop. Drag them anywhere or double-click to open pet care options.", "Desktop Pet Active"]
8: ["Claim Your Free Welcome Accessory Bundle", "Complete onboarding today to receive an exclusive starter pet hat and 100 bonus pet treats!", "Exclusive Starter Reward Unlocked"]
9: ["Sign Your Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your pet an official name and seal the adoption certificate to finalize your bond.", "Enter Pet Name", "Stamp & Confirm Adoption"]

verdicts.problem: Offers free gifts/extras and creates urgency to complete onboarding today.
